biggest_catch: Bonus value at the advertised ceiling (estimated ~$2,000 at 1.0¢ per point) minus the $375 annual fee = ~$1,625 first-year net — but the offer is variable/YMMV: Amex tells you your exact amount only at application, so only pursue it with spending already planned.
catches: Only pursue this bonus with spending you were already going to make — manufactured or extra spending can erase the gain.

Amex once-per-lifetime rule: the welcome offer is generally not available if you have or have had this exact card before; Amex also considers your history as an Amex Card Member and the number of cards opened/closed.
Applying for this card triggers a hard credit inquiry — do not apply unless you are ready for it.
This card's purchase APR is roughly 20%+; carrying a balance can wipe out the entire bonus — pay the statement balance in full every month.
The offer is 'as high as' 200,000 points — your actual offer may be less and is revealed only after you submit the application.
The $375 annual fee is not waived in year one.
You must be a legitimate business to apply — a sole proprietor applying with an SSN qualifies; the account will only be used for business purposes per the issuer's terms.

payout_quote: After you submit your application and before you are approved for the Card, we will tell you the exact amount of Membership Rewards® points which you are eligible to earn with your Welcome Offer (if you are approved and accept the Card), which will be an amount as high as 200,000 points. steps: Open the official Amex Business Gold terms page and confirm the 'As High As 200,000' offer and $15,000 threshold.
Confirm you have not had this card before (Amex once-per-lifetime) and that you have a legitimate business (sole proprietor with SSN is fine).
Apply through the official Amex application — it will tell you your exact welcome-offer amount before approval; withdraw if it is not worth it to you.
If you accept, spend $15,000 in planned business purchases in the first 3 months (eligible purchases exclude fees, gift cards, prepaid reloads, P2P payments).
Pay the balance in full every month — the $375 fee plus any interest destroys the math otherwise.
Monitor your Membership Rewards account; points are credited 8-12 weeks after you meet the Threshold Amount.
timing: Membership Rewards® points will be credited to your account 8-12 weeks after you have met the Threshold Amount.
